messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline. Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of the world in an alternate universe where the industrial revolution never happened

message.content:
year one of the Quiet Centuries opened with harvest bells and no smoke over the hills, while guilds of windwrights tuned the spires and the old seas kept their salt calendars year
decade ten saw the first glass moons hung in the canopies of the city, catching dew and dreaming it into light, and the scholars of slow time began their long ledgers in ink made from blue moss decade
century three arrived with the Great Listening, when the mountains were carved into resonant chambers and the people learned to speak with their roots, sharing dreams through the mycelial threads beneath every market square century
summer of the pale tide brought a forest that walked on ten thousand fungal legs, offering shelter to the refugees of the drowned coast and leaving behind silver spores that hummed with forgotten lullabies summer
winter of the last ember closed the old age as the final coal bank froze into a museum of red silence, and children pressed their ears to the stones, hearing not industry but the steady patient breath of a world that chose to remain winter
